allow: PowerShell(foreach \($c in @\('git --version','node --version','npm --version','python --version','pip --version','docker --version','docker compose version','psql --version'\)\) { $out = try { Invoke-Expression $c 2>$null | Select-Object -First 1 } catch { 'ABSENT' }; if \(-not $out\) { $out = 'ABSENT' }; "{0,-24} {1}" -f $c, $out }; "docker engine: " + \(try { docker info --format '{{.ServerVersion}}' 2>$null } catch { 'injoignable' }\))

PowerShell($v = docker info --format '{{.ServerVersion}}' 2>$null; if \($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0 -and $v\) { "Moteur Docker actif : $v" } else { "Moteur Docker injoignable \(Docker Desktop arrete ?\)" }; if \(Test-Path .git\) { 'git: depot present' } else { 'git: pas de depot' })
